tests.name: a healthy revision change refreshes history without becoming an outage
a real outage becomes unavailable only after 60 seconds, keeping the actual saved age
live observation ages use bounded minutes and hours
a pending retry keeps the outage status until the caller observes recovery
a superseded history read shows Refreshing history rather than a source error
the fixed row retains saved-read proof wording and the failure cause
a continuously superseded read gains the canonical saved caption at the shared grace boundary
run detail lists one session row per agent context with a short session id
the row names the slot and tmux target before any copy
copy buttons are labeled as copy, not as execute
Open on host reloads a dead pane only while the run is still live
Open on host refuses transferred or unproved slot ownership
switching runs clears the bound terminal context so the next run cannot inherit it
copy buttons use only the command the gateway built
row state carries the structured liveness the gateway proved
an unsupported runner surfaces its reason and copies nothing
a missing attach command is an error state, never a silent no-op copy
a refused clipboard keeps the proved liveness and never reports Copied
a gateway-side failure is not marked as a blocked copy
two same-role reviewer rows stay distinct so each copies its own session
the request guard is keyed per context so one row cannot strand another
slot-free native review rows do not fall back to tmux controls
disclosures default closed and remember choices only for their owner, run and panel
disclosure remains interactive when browser storage refuses both reads and writes
